model.$description: Colour standard for every Vivatheca model, print file and render (Luke, 2026-11-06). Change colours here, then run `pnpm tokens`.

tooth.$description: Realistic white teeth (wisdom tooth model v1.3 standard)

mucosa.$description: Lining (alveolar) mucosa below the gum: redder and darker than the gum, as the mucogingival junction looks in the mouth (2026-11-10)

necroticPulp.$description: Dead (necrotic) dental pulp: grey-brown, apart from decay and healthy pulp

abscess.$description: Pus and inflamed tissue of an abscess or periapical lesion: yellow-green, apart from dentine and bone (2026-11-07)

cyst.$description: Cyst (odontogenic cysts; matches the head and neck diagrams)

enamelCut.$description: Cut face of enamel in sectioned views: bluish white (2026-11-07)

dentineCut.$description: Cut face of dentine in sectioned views: pale straw yellow like real dentine (2026-11-08)

cementum.$description: Root cementum (root surface below the CEJ only), surface and cut face: dull light ochre, a little darker than dentine; drawn thicker than real (2026-11-08)

boneCut.$description: Cut face of bone in sectioned views: warm mid brown like cut cancellous bone with marrow, darker than every tooth layer and soft tissue (2026-11-08)

airflow.$description: Airflow arrows: air going the normal way

airLeak.$description: Airflow arrows: air escaping the wrong way (e.g. through the nose)

hardware.$description: Braces, implants, bridges, dentures, plates and screws

babyTeeth.$description: Development and orthodontic models only: baby teeth blue

adultTeeth.$description: Development and orthodontic models only: adult teeth yellow

muscle.$description: Muscle (masseter, temporalis, levator veli palatini sling): muscle red

muscleDeep.$description: Deep muscle (pterygoids): lighter muscle red so it reads apart from masseter and temporalis

disc.$description: Joint disc and cartilage (TMJ disc): light blue

printLabel.$description: Raised label on the base plate
